content.expected_result: Sibling current documents and original committed content remain byte-identical.
preconditions: A disposable Saga has zeta, Architecture.v2 and data-model current boards with valid pins, preserved in a real Git commit.

steps.action: Publish updated complete data-model content and reload each named board.
steps.expected_result: Only data-model current content changes; sibling contents and identities remain unchanged.

steps.action: Compare sibling current bytes and inspect the original committed board content through Git.
steps.expected_result: Sibling bytes are unchanged and historical Git content retains its original pins.

content.title: Publish named whiteboards without changing their siblings
